standard_prerequisites.name: Functoriality of the Koszul complex in the defining module map
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the isomorphism of complexes from the isomorphism of free modules.

core_obligations: Write the new sequence in terms of the matrix and the old sequence (proof lines 6637-6639).
Observe that the transposed matrix gives an isomorphism of finite free modules intertwining the two maps (proof lines 6639-6640).
Apply functoriality of the Koszul complex (proof lines 6641-6643).
proof_roadmap: Express the new sequence via the matrix (proof lines 6637-6639).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that replacing a sequence by the sequence obtained from it by an invertible matrix of coefficients does not change the isomorphism class of the Koszul complex. The proof writes the new sequence as the image of the old one under the linear map given by the transpose of the matrix, observes that this linear map is an isomorphism of free modules of the same rank, and appeals to the functoriality of the Koszul complex, which turns an isomorphism of the underlying modules into an isomorphism of the complexes.
